routing.icalpa_official_submission_rule: ICALPA's 3-Sep-2026 routing reply states that official submissions should go to registro@icalpa.org for formal entry registration and internal transfer.
routing.legacy_note: Legacy/individual ICALPA-domain addresses were also used historically. They are not treated as current official submission channels; 3077@icalpa.com is preserved as a historic lawyer/colegiado-domain address in the source record.

prior_independence_language.dip80_20aug: No se pretende ejercer presión impropia sobre el ponente ni exigir una sanción. Se pretende que ... el Colegio ejerza visiblemente su función mediante una decisión motivada o un plan finito, fechado y responsable.
prior_independence_language.dip79_20aug: La mejor protección para la independencia de la Abogacía y para el derecho de defensa es precisamente que exista una regla clara antes de que esa situación se produzca.
prior_independence_language.proposed_regional_extension: Request a conflict-cleared rapporteur with sufficient independence, institutional mandate and continuity to take the matter to a reasoned outcome; any attempted informal contact, call, representation or pressure outside the file should be logged and routed into the formal record.
